verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a dedicated sandbox environment with test card data and expected sandbox responses. API endpoints are selected per environment, and its AI integration prompt targets the sandbox environment. This lets AI-native users test without hitting production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox data/credential isolation from production, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Use the card data below to test EBANX Pay-in Direct in the sandbox environment. Each row includes a ready-to-use card object, the expected sandbox response, and a 3DS indicator
